motion: The camera does not move. Both women keep their white clean-room suits on the whole time. The old woman zips her white suit up to her chin with a look of deep suspicion. Behind them a man hopping on one leg loses his balance and grabs a bench. The woman in cream, her white suit still half on, turns her head to the old woman and speaks, dry and slow, each word separate. She says: Five years, one toilet. Now he's fussy. Then she closes her mouth and looks away. The camera does not move.
